correctness_confidence.basis: Independent verification of Eqs. (1)-(11), Theorems 2.1-2.4, Corollary 2.3, Proposition 2.5, and numerical spot checks on Steane [[7,1,3]], Shor [[9,1,3]], and d=2 rotated surface codes confirm all mathematical claims and exact rational values.

novelty.basis: Generalizes surface-code parity results in [9] to arbitrary [[n,1,d]] CSS codes; Theorem 2.2's exact 0-1 swap-point binary law via K_Z = S_Z cap S_Z^perp and Corollary 2.3's 90-degree orientation transition are sharp original contributions.

reproducibility.basis: Exact formulas, code parameters, random seed, and schema rules are stated in the manuscript, though the random-code sampling distribution in Experiment 3 is under-specified and external GitHub/Lean/Python artifacts were not inspected.

rigor.basis: Analytical proofs are complete and precise with explicit hypotheses, though Section 3.1 and Section 5 overstate the Lean 4 kernel scope relative to the bit/integer lemmas cataloged in Table 1.

significance.basis: Provides clean structural laws and exact-Q benchmarks for coherent Z-rotation decoding in k=1 CSS codes, though restricted to single logical qubits, spatially uniform rotations, and zero stochastic noise.

potential_errors: Bit-endianness convention for canonical coset rep e_s should be noted.
Zero-probability syndrome phase convention at p_s(theta)=0 (e.g. Shor at pi/6).
strengths: Theorem 2.1 cleanly generalizes the parity dichotomy to all even-Z-stabilizer [[n,1,d]] CSS codes.
Theorem 2.2 proves exact {1/2, 1} swap-point quantization via F2 harmonic analysis on K_Z.
Corollary 2.3 proves a sharp 90-degree orientation phase transition on even-d rotated surface codes.
Independent hand checks confirm all formulas and Table 2 numbers.
strong_novelty_candidates: Theorem 2.2: Universal 0-1 swap-point binary quantization law
Theorem 2.1: General CSS odd-even coherent error dichotomy
summary: The manuscript establishes a complete algebraic classification of entanglement fidelity for arbitrary [[n, 1, d]] CSS codes under uniform coherent Z-rotations. All theorems, corollaries, propositions, and numerical spot checks verify mathematically, with only minor presentation, notation, and Lean-scope wording issues.
weaknesses: Section 3.1/5 phrasing overstates Lean 4 scope beyond the 18 bit/integer lemmas in Table 1.
Minor notation overloading between angle theta and p = sin^2(theta).
